purpose: Build an ordered multi-step recovery sequence from available tools.
policy: PASS iff {goal string, sequence: list of >=3 {step:int, tool:str, params:object}}.
grading_logic: goal is a string and sequence is a list of >=3 well-formed step objects (step int, tool str, params dict).
known_limitations: Capability test: structure-only grading (no semantic verification of the reasoning/calculation prose beyond the checked fields).
